WITHDRAWING MY SUPPORT FOR THIS BEAD'S SUSPICION. I wrote that your 'per-call recomputation of plan/fit-invariant work' hypothesis was correct and quantified it at 53 percent. That was a profiler misreading - I read summaryRprof's by.total column, which counts samples with a function anywhere on the stack, as if it were time spent inside it. Direct timing: relation_fit_capabilities(fit) costs 0.003 s against a 0.275 s call, or 1.1 percent. Across 577 nodes it totals 1.7 s.

So the invariant-work hypothesis is not confirmed by me either way. It remains open and untested rather than supported. Detail on bd-01KZZWP1PA6N3NZQGZ1S9JTH1Q, now withdrawn and closed.
